name: Doc-Pipeline (free tier): Email → Claude extraction → Google Sheet

nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Point this at the mailbox that receives orders/invoices. Create IMAP credentials in n8n → Credentials.

nodes.name: Claude: extract fields
nodes.notes: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an environment variable on your n8n instance (or replace with a Header Auth credential).

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Pick your spreadsheet and sheet after importing. Columns are auto-mapped from the extracted fields.

nodes.name: Exceptions sheet (nothing lost silently)
nodes.notes: Emails the model could not parse land here with the error — review them by hand.
